basis: Visitors: the 総括報告書 main volume, p. 9 (section 3 来場者の動向, 来場者数), states 545,931 total entries (延べ入込者) for the 89 days of the 9th Triennale, 13 July to 10 November 2024, counted as visits and including 3,848 event participants.
Area: the Arquitectura Viva project data line gives a floor area of 1,932 m2 for the building; no visitor, staff or accounts figure was read from the operator's own pages.
No figure is recorded from the museum or the Ishibashi Foundation pages that were opened, so all scale fields are null.
Visitors: the 2024 (令和6年度) 事業報告書, p. 1, section II-1 states 55,527 paid and free entries to the five special exhibitions over 256 days, 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, counted as visits.

Area: the architect Gluckman Tang's project page states 32,000 square feet of exhibition space, converted to 2,973 m2; no annual visitor count is recorded because the sources opened give only the 18,743,595 total from 2003 to 2022.

Visitors: the 年報 (Annual Report 2025, PDF p. 114, 令和6年度月別利用統計) totals 758,066 exhibition entries from April 2024 to March 2025 (622,671 special and 135,395 collection exhibitions); area: the 施設概要 on PDF p. 116 lists 4,300 m2 of special exhibition rooms and 3,100 m2 of collection rooms, which sum to 7,400 m2.
No figure is recorded from the ICC pages that were opened, so all scale fields are null.

Visitors: the 2025 事業報告書 (1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026), p. 3, states 307,565 entries over 223 open days including 284,406 paid; staff: p. 22 section 庶務の概要 2 職員 states 17 staff (職員 17名) besides 24 temporary staff, which are not counted in the 17.
No figure is recorded because the operator's 令和6年度 事業実績 report on rekibun.or.jp could not be opened.
No figure is recorded from the museum's own about page, so all scale fields are null.

Visitors: p. 7 of the Towada city 事務事業評価 sheet lists 152,446 entries for 平成30年度 (April 2018 to March 2019); finance: p. 6 事業費実績 totals 107,012 thousand yen, funded by 17,705 thousand from a power-siting fund, 5,000 thousand from a power-siting grant and 80,788 thousand from general city funds (public 103,493 thousand) plus 3,519 thousand in parking fees (earned), and it is a city project cost line including the 53,862 thousand management fee, not the full museum accounts.

Visitors: the 令和3年度 annual report, p. 3 事業総括表, totals 56,058 entries (April 2021 to March 2022) including 6,816 at hired venues, counted as visits and excluding 10,113 online views; staff: the organisation chart on p. 2 gives 41 staff (職員数 41人) as of 1 April 2021.
